equations_of_record: tectonics/docs/I01_PHYSICAL_CONTRACT.md and the method documents under sources; this record restates no equation as new authority, and its separation negative example is a refusal case, not a law
completion_semantics: No field in this record is a pass/fail flag and no combination of status values means complete. Even if every row were selected_bounded_evidence and every MC item closed, a generated planet would still need the I02-I11 implementation and plan cases A-K. I01 completion remains the plan's I01 finish rule plus review. Scientific acceptance, Diadem canon, commit and publication are separate decisions.
acceptance_boundary: I01 selects equations, required inputs, support, ownership and bounded feasibility. Original full-event closes_when clauses remain mandatory for the named later implementation owners, not a circular requirement to finish I07 before I02. Analytical verification can replace inaccessible published reproduction for method selection, never physical-event acceptance or empirical validation.
stale_wording_rule: Wording that infers full-generator or physical-event acceptance from I01 selection/feasibility is stale. I01 completion itself follows the plan's finish rule and integrating-owner review. A ladder extrapolation is never a separation certificate or proven handoff bound, crustal disconnection is not plate separation, and a supplied magma input is not the melt-derived generated route.
i01_selection_checkpoint: All seven MC choices now have selected equations/input/support contracts and bounded feasibility or a declared supported branch. Full-event closes_when and separation.outstanding_choices remain unwaived later physical-acceptance requirements; final I01 finish-rule review belongs to the integrating owner.

freshness_vs_validity.freshness: register_status mirrors tectonics/evidence/current-evidence.json. Current means the receipt bytes and declared bindings match, not physical acceptance. Active row, selection and source references follow the registered successor; retained receipt entries keep their original bytes and classification. Verify with tools/check_current_evidence.py and tests/test_current_evidence.py; no old receipt is repinned.
freshness_vs_validity.validity: Every cited I01 receipt is a bounded control recording scientific_acceptance false or a PASS_BOUNDED_..._ONLY status. The B1 receipt is descriptive and the New World receipts are historical. None is generated-world, calibration or I01-completion evidence.
freshness_vs_validity.bound_by: bound_by names the current receipt whose registered source bindings list the file (usually /source_sha256; the Gibbs provider uses /source_bindings). unbound means no current receipt binds it. This record binds nothing, and neither of its own two files is bound.

negative_example.status: required refusal case for any separation logic
negative_example.field: h = H_c - u/c for u <= u_a = c (H_c - a w); h = a w exp(-(u - u_a)/(c a w)) for u > u_a; fixed physical length w > 0 (for example a width set by the D2 length ell), a > 0, c > 0, a w < H_c; slope continuous at u_a
negative_example.truth: at u = c H_c, h = a w/e > 0; h stays positive at every finite opening for every fixed w
negative_example.truncated_ladder: admit only rungs h_k = H_c 2^-k >= c_w w; if a <= c_w every admitted rung lies on the linear branch, u_k = c (H_c - h_k) and every increment ratio is exactly 1/2; given at least the five rungs its window needs, the I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 5 ratio rule (ratio_max 0.9, ratio_spread 0.02) reports FINITE_LIMIT, exponent 1 and the false limit c H_c; halving w leaves that limit unchanged
negative_example.required_outcome: refused: no event, finite-limit proof or handoff-error bound; the extrapolation may be reported only as a diagnostic

evidence_rules: A ladder extrapolation is a diagnostic, never a certificate or a proven handoff-error bound. The chain's status rests on the declared power law's exact asymptotics, which its ladder only corroborates (I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 5, obligations 1 and 3); a resolved field has no such asymptotics.

Grid refinement (N versus 2N) at a fixed physical regularisation length, the D2 ell, tests the numerical convergence of one physical model. Changing ell changes the physics (IN-04) and is reported as a sensitivity, never as refinement.
The shear-zone width and the geometric neck width are measured separately; neither is established as equal to the other or to ell.
Detection levels are reporting levels: a lower floor or level does not turn a diagnostic into an event, and no smaller cutoff may replace a refused one.
Every comparison reports the neck's stress, pressure, temperature and strain-rate ranges against declared coefficient support (I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 5, obligation 1).

The fixed-width neck of I01_BREAKUP_CLOSURE section 2 and the negative example's exponential branch are special cases.
